161:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu;

163:   uint16_t sequence;
164:   int ret;
165: 
166:   if (payload_length > BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOT_SIZE - sizeof(uint32_t) -
167:                        sizeof(*cpdu) - sizeof(*header))
168:     {
169:       return -E2BIG;
170:     }
171: 
172:   if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
173:     {
174:       return -ENOLINK;
175:     }
176: 
177:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
178:   wifi_command_reap();
179:   slot = wifi_command_alloc();
180:   if (slot == NULL)
181:     {
182:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
183:       return -ENOMEM;
184:     }
185: 
186:   cpdu = (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)(slot->bytes + sizeof(uint32_t));
187:   header = (struct bk7258_wifi_msg_hdr *)(cpdu + 1);
188:   sequence = ++g_wifi.next_sequence;
189:   memset(cpdu, 0, sizeof(*cpdu) + sizeof(*header) + payload_length);
190:   cpdu->length = sizeof(*cpdu) + sizeof(*header) + payload_length;
191:   header->cmd_id = command;
192:   header->cmd_sn = sequence;
193:   header->length = payload_length;
194:   if (payload != NULL && payload_length != 0)
195:     {
196:       memcpy(header + 1, payload, payload_length);
197:     }
198: 
199:   g_wifi.waiting_id = command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET;
200:   g_wifi.waiting_sequence = sequence;
201:   g_wifi.command_result = -ETIMEDOUT;
202:   g_wifi.command_length = 0;
203:   ret = wifi_send_node(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_TX_CHANNEL, 0,
204:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu,
205:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu, 1);
206:   if (ret < 0)
207:     {
208:       *(uint32_t *)slot->bytes = BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
209:       slot->owned = false;
210:       g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
211:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
212:       return ret;
213:     }
214: 
215:   ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_wifi.command_sem,
216:                                        WIFI_COMMAND_TIMEOUT);
217:   if (ret >= 0)
218:     {
219:       ret = g_wifi.command_result;
220:     }
221: 
222:   if (ret >= 0 && result != NULL && result_size != 0)
223:     {
224:       uint16_t copy = g_wifi.command_length < result_size ?
225:                       g_wifi.command_length : result_size;
226:       memcpy(result, g_wifi.command_data, copy);
227:     }
228: 
229:   g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
230:   wifi_command_reap();
231:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
232:   return ret;
233: }

252: {

254: 
255:   if (wifi_cp_pointer(pattern_address, sizeof(uint32_t)))
256:     {
257:       *(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)pattern_address =
258:         BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
259:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");

263: static void wifi_handle_command(uint32_t cpdu_address)
264: {
265:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
266:   struct bk7258_wifi_event_hdr event;
267:   uint32_t event_address;
268:   uint16_t length;
269: 
270:   if (!wifi_cp_pointer(cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu)))
271:     {
272:       return;
273:     }
274: 
275:   memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu));
276:   event_address = cpdu_address + sizeof(cpdu);
277:   if (cpdu.length < sizeof(cpdu) + sizeof(event) ||
278:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address, sizeof(event)))
279:     {
280:       return;
281:     }
282: 
283:   memcpy(&event, (const void *)(uintptr_t)event_address, sizeof(event));
284:   length = event.length;
285:   if (length > cpdu.length - sizeof(cpdu) - sizeof(event) ||
286:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address + WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET, length))
287:     {
288:       return;
289:     }
290: 
291:   if (event.id >= BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET)
292:     {
293:       if (event.id == g_wifi.waiting_id &&
294:           event.sequence == g_wifi.waiting_sequence)
295:         {
296:           if (length > sizeof(g_wifi.command_data))
297:             {
298:               length = sizeof(g_wifi.command_data);
299:             }
300:           if (length != 0)
301:             {
302:               memcpy(g_wifi.command_data,
303:                      (const void *)(uintptr_t)(event_address +
304:                                                WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET),
305:                      length);
306:             }
307:           g_wifi.command_length = length;
308:           g_wifi.command_result = OK;
309:           nxsem_post(&g_wifi.command_sem);
310:         }
311:     }
312:   else if (event.id == BK7258_WIFI_EVT_IPV4_IND)
313:     {
314:       wifi_set_carrier(true);
315:     }
316:   else if (event.id == BK7258_WIFI_EVT_WIFI_EVENT_IND && length >= 4)
317:     {
318:       uint16_t event_id;
319: 
320:       memcpy(&event_id,
321:              (const void *)(uintptr_t)(event_address +
322:                                        WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET),
323:              sizeof(event_id));
324:       if (event_id == BK7258_WIFI_EVENT_CONNECTED)
325:         {
326:           wifi_set_carrier(true);
327:         }
328:       else if (event_id == BK7258_WIFI_EVENT_DISCONNECTED)
329:         {
330:           wifi_set_carrier(false);
331:         }
332:     }
333:   else if (event.id == 3u)
334:     {
335:       wifi_set_carrier(false);
336:     }
337:   else if (event.id == 8u)
338:     {
339:       g_wifi.scan_running = false;
340:     }
341: 
342:   wifi_release_cp_command(cpdu_address);
343: }

345: static void wifi_handle_command_list(const struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node)
346: {
347:   uint32_t seen[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
348:   uint32_t address = node->head;
349:   unsigned int count;
350: 
351:   if (node->channel != 0 || node->num == 0 ||
352:       node->num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
353:     {
354:       return;
355:     }
356: 
357:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
358:     {
359:       struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
360:       unsigned int previous;
361: 
362:       if (!wifi_cp_pointer(address, sizeof(cpdu)))
363:         {
364:           return;
365:         }
366:       for (previous = 0; previous < count; previous++)
367:         {
368:           if (seen[previous] == address)
369:             {
370:               return;
371:             }
372:         }
373:       if ((count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
374:         {
375:           return;
376:         }
377: 
378:       seen[count] = address;
379:       memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address, sizeof(cpdu));
380:       wifi_handle_command(address);
381:       address = cpdu.next;
382:     }
383: 
384:   if (address != 0)
385:     {
386:       return;
387:     }
388: }

408: static bool wifi_copy_rx_frame(uint32_t cpdu_address,
409:                                struct wifi_rx_packet *packet)
410: {
411:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
412:   struct bk7258_wifi_pbuf pbuf;
413:   uint32_t pbuf_address;
414: 
415:   if (!wifi_cp_pointer(cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu)) ||
416:       cpdu_address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START + sizeof(pbuf))
417:     {
418:       return false;
419:     }
420: 
421:   memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu));
422:   pbuf_address = cpdu_address - sizeof(pbuf);
423:   if (!wifi_cp_pointer(pbuf_address, sizeof(pbuf)))
424:     {
425:       return false;
426:     }
427: 
428:   memcpy(&pbuf, (const void *)(uintptr_t)pbuf_address, sizeof(pbuf));
429:   if ((cpdu.flags & 1u) != 0 || pbuf.next != 0 || pbuf.len == 0 ||
430:       pbuf.len > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_FRAME || pbuf.tot_len != pbuf.len ||
431:       !wifi_cp_pointer(pbuf.payload, pbuf.len))
432:     {
433:       return false;
434:     }
435: 
436:   memcpy(packet->frame, (const void *)(uintptr_t)pbuf.payload, pbuf.len);
437:   packet->length = pbuf.len;
438:   return true;
439: }

441: static bool wifi_recycle_append(uint32_t *head, uint32_t *tail,
442:                                 uint8_t *count, uint32_t cpdu_address)
443: {
444:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu;
445:   struct bk7258_wifi_pbuf *pbuf;
446:   uint32_t pbuf_address;
447: 
448:   if (cpdu_address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START + sizeof(*pbuf))
449:     {
450:       return false;
451:     }
452: 
453:   pbuf_address = cpdu_address - sizeof(*pbuf);
454:   if (!wifi_cp_pointer(cpdu_address, sizeof(*cpdu)) ||
455:       !wifi_cp_pointer(pbuf_address, sizeof(*pbuf)))
456:     {
457:       return false;
458:     }
459: 
460:   cpdu = (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address;
461:   pbuf = (struct bk7258_wifi_pbuf *)(uintptr_t)pbuf_address;
462:   if (pbuf->ref == 0 || pbuf->ref == UINT8_MAX)
463:     {
464:       return false;
465:     }
466: 
467:   /* Match wdrv_txdata_sender(): CP drops one reference before pbuf_free(). */
468: 
469:   pbuf->ref++;
470:   cpdu->flags |= 1u;
471:   cpdu->next = 0;
472:   if (*tail != 0)
473:     {
474:       ((struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)(uintptr_t)*tail)->next = cpdu_address;
475:     }
476:   else
477:     {
478:       *head = cpdu_address;
479:     }
480: 
481:   *tail = cpdu_address;
482:   (*count)++;
483:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
484:   return true;
485: }

487: static bool wifi_queue_recycle(uint32_t head, uint32_t tail, uint8_t count)
488: {
489:   irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
490:   struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node;
491: 
492:   if (g_wifi.recycle_count == WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE)
493:     {
494:       up_irq_restore(flags);
495:       return false;
496:     }
497: 
498:   node = &g_wifi.recycle[g_wifi.recycle_tail];
499:   memset(node, 0, sizeof(*node));
500:   node->head = head;
501:   node->tail = tail;
502:   node->channel = 2;
503:   node->num = count;
504:   g_wifi.recycle_tail = (g_wifi.recycle_tail + 1) % WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE;
505:   g_wifi.recycle_count++;
506:   up_irq_restore(flags);
507:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
508:   return true;
509: }
510: 
511: static void wifi_flush_recycle(void)
512: {
513:   struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node node;
514:   irqstate_t flags;
515:   int ret;
516: 
517:   for (;;)
518:     {
519:       flags = up_irq_save();
520:       if (g_wifi.recycle_count == 0)
521:         {
522:           up_irq_restore(flags);
523:           return;
524:         }
525: 
526:       node = g_wifi.recycle[g_wifi.recycle_head];
527:       up_irq_restore(flags);
528:       ret = wifi_send_node(BK7258_WIFI_DATA_TX_CHANNEL, node.channel,
529:                            node.head, node.tail, node.num);
530:       if (ret < 0)
531:         {
532:           return;
533:         }
534: 
535:       flags = up_irq_save();
536:       g_wifi.recycle_head = (g_wifi.recycle_head + 1) % WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE;
537:       g_wifi.recycle_count--;
538:       up_irq_restore(flags);
539:     }
540: }

542: static void wifi_handle_data(const struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node)
543: {
544:   uint32_t seen[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
545:   uint32_t address = node->head;
546:   uint32_t recycle_head = 0;
547:   uint32_t recycle_tail = 0;
548:   uint8_t recycle_count = 0;
549:   unsigned int count;
550:   bool valid = true;
551: 
552:   if (node->channel != 2 || node->num == 0 ||
553:       node->num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
554:     {
555:       return;
556:     }
557: 
558:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
559:     {
560:       struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
561:       struct wifi_tx_slot *tx;
562:       unsigned int previous;
563: 
564:       if (address == 0)
565:         {
566:           valid = false;
567:           break;
568:         }
569: 
570:       for (previous = 0; previous < count; previous++)
571:         {
572:           if (seen[previous] == address)
573:             {
574:               valid = false;
575:               break;
576:             }
577:         }
578: 
579:       if (!valid)
580:         {
581:           break;
582:         }
583: 
584:       seen[count] = address;
585:       tx = wifi_tx_slot(address);
586:       if (tx != NULL)
587:         {
588:           struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *ap_cpdu =
589:             (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)tx->headroom;
590: 
591:           if (!tx->active || (ap_cpdu->flags & 1u) == 0 ||
592:               (count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
593:             {
594:               valid = false;
595:               break;
596:             }
597: 
598:           netpkt_free(&g_wifi.lower, tx->packet, NETPKT_TX);
599:           tx->packet = NULL;
600:           tx->active = false;
601:           netdev_lower_txdone(&g_wifi.lower);
602:           address = ap_cpdu->next;
603:           continue;
604:         }
605: 
606:       if (!wifi_cp_pointer(address, sizeof(cpdu)))
607:         {
608:           valid = false;
609:           break;
610:         }
611: 
612:       memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address, sizeof(cpdu));
613:       if ((count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
614:         {
615:           valid = false;
616:           break;
617:         }
618: 
619:       if (g_wifi.packet_count < WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE)
620:         {
621:           struct wifi_rx_packet *packet =
622:             &g_wifi.packets[g_wifi.packet_tail];
623: 
624:           if (wifi_copy_rx_frame(address, packet))
625:             {
626:               g_wifi.packet_tail = (g_wifi.packet_tail + 1) %
627:                                    WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
628:               g_wifi.packet_count++;
629:             }
630:         }
631: 
632:       if (!wifi_recycle_append(&recycle_head, &recycle_tail,
633:                                &recycle_count, address))
634:         {
635:           valid = false;
636:           break;
637:         }
638:       address = cpdu.next;
639:     }
640: 
641:   if (valid && count == node->num && address != 0)
642:     {
643:       valid = false;
644:     }
645: 
646:   if (valid && g_wifi.packet_count != 0)
647:     {
648:       netdev_lower_rxready(&g_wifi.lower);
649:     }
650: 
651:   if (recycle_count != 0 &&
652:       !wifi_queue_recycle(recycle_head, recycle_tail, recycle_count))
653:     {
654:       wifi_set_carrier(false);
655:     }
656: }

721: static int wifi_worker(int argc, char **argv)
722: {
723:   (void)argc;
724:   (void)argv;
725:   for (;;)
726:     {
727:       struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node node;
728:       irqstate_t flags;
729: 
730:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_wifi.work_sem,
731:                                            WIFI_WORK_INTERVAL);
732:       wifi_command_reap();
733:       wifi_flush_recycle();
734:       for (;;)
735:         {
736:           flags = up_irq_save();
737:           if (g_wifi.node_count == 0)
738:             {
739:               up_irq_restore(flags);
740:               break;
741:             }
742: 
743:           node = g_wifi.nodes[g_wifi.node_head];
744:           g_wifi.node_head = (g_wifi.node_head + 1) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
745:           g_wifi.node_count--;
746:           up_irq_restore(flags);
747:           if (node.channel == 0)
748:             {
749:               wifi_handle_command_list(&node);
750:             }
751:           else if (node.channel == 2)
752:             {
753:               wifi_handle_data(&node);
754:             }
755:         }
756: 
757:       wifi_flush_recycle();
758:     }
759: 
760:   return OK;
761: }

776: static int wifi_transmit(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *lower, netpkt_t *packet)
777: {
778:   struct wifi_tx_slot *tx = NULL;
779:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu;
780:   unsigned int length;
781:   unsigned int i;
782:   int ret;
783: 
784:   length = netpkt_getdatalen(lower, packet);
785:   if (!g_wifi.carrier)
786:     {
787:       return -ENETDOWN;
788:     }
789:   if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_FRAME)
790:     {
791:       return -EMSGSIZE;
792:     }
793: 
794:   for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_BK7258_WIFI_TX_SLOTS; i++)
795:     {
796:       if (!g_wifi.tx[i].active)
797:         {
798:           tx = &g_wifi.tx[i];
799:           break;
800:         }
801:     }
802:   if (tx == NULL)
803:     {
804:       return -EBUSY;
805:     }
806: 
807:   memset(&tx->pbuf, 0, sizeof(tx->pbuf));
808:   cpdu = (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)tx->headroom;
809:   memset(cpdu, 0, sizeof(*cpdu));
810:   tx->pbuf.payload = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)tx->frame;
811:   tx->pbuf.tot_len = length;
812:   tx->pbuf.len = length;
813:   tx->pbuf.type_internal = WIFI_PBUF_TYPE_RAM;
814:   tx->pbuf.ref = 1;
815:   cpdu->length = sizeof(*cpdu) + length;
816:   cpdu->type_dst = 2u;
817:   ret = netpkt_copyout(lower, tx->frame, packet, length, 0);
818:   if (ret < 0)
819:     {
820:       return ret;
821:     }
822: 
823:   tx->packet = packet;
824:   tx->active = true;

322: static void select_recovery_epoch(void)
323: {
324:   unsigned int i;
325:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = NULL;
326: 
327:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
328:     {
329:       if (!g_recovery[i].probe.quarantine &&
330:           !g_recovery[i].reset_sent && !g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
331:         {
332:           epoch = &g_recovery[i];
333:           g_recovery_index = i;
334:           break;
335:         }
336:     }
337: 
338:   if (epoch == NULL)
339:     {
340:       uint32_t newest = 0;
341: 
342:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
343:         {
344:           if (g_recovery[i].probe.order >= newest)
345:             {
346:               newest = g_recovery[i].probe.order;
347:               epoch = &g_recovery[i];
348:               g_recovery_index = i;
349:             }
350:         }
351: 
352:       epoch->replay = true;
353:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
354:     }
355:   else
356:     {
357:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
358:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
359:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
360:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
361:     }
362: 
363:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
364:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
365:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
366:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
367:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
368: }
369: 
370: static void begin_abort(int result)
371: {
372:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
373: 
374:   if (g_active.busy)
375:     {
376:       g_active.quarantine = true;
377:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
378:     }
379: 
380:   if (probe != NULL)
381:     {
382:       probe->quarantine = true;
383:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
384:     }
385: 
386:   fail_pending(result);
387:   g_probe_requested = false;
388:   select_recovery_epoch();
389: }
390: 
391: static struct ack_slot *alloc_ack_slot(void)
392: {
393:   unsigned int i;
394: 
395:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
396:     {
397:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
398:         {
399:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_QUEUED;
400:           return &g_ack_slots[i];
401:         }
402:     }
403: 
404:   g_stats.ack_overflow++;
405:   return NULL;
406: }
407: 
408: static int dispatch_locked(void)
409: {
410:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
411:   struct active_transaction *active;
412:   struct logical_channel *channel;
413:   unsigned int i;
414:   int ret;
415: 
416:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
417: 
418:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
419:     {
420:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
421:         {
422:           continue;
423:         }
424: 
425:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
426:       if (ret < 0)
427:         {
428:           return ret;
429:         }
430: 
431:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
432:     }
433: 
434:   if (g_reset_pending)
435:     {
436:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
437:       if (ret < 0)
438:         {
439:           return ret;
440:         }
441: 
442:       g_reset_pending = false;
443:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
444:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
445:     }
446: 
447:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
448:     {
449:       return OK;
450:     }
451: 
452:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
453:     {
454:       channel = &g_channels[i];
455:       if (!channel->queued)
456:         {
457:           continue;
458:         }
459: 
460:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
461:         {
462:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
463:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
464:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
465:             {
466:               continue;
467:             }
468: 
469:           active = &epoch->probe;
470:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
471:             {
472:               return -ENOLINK;
473:             }
474:         }
475:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
476:         {
477:           active = &g_active;
478:           if (active->quarantine)
479:             {
480:               return -ENOLINK;
481:             }
482:         }
483:       else
484:         {
485:           return OK;
486:         }
487: 
488:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
489:         {
490:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
491:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
492:                  sizeof(active->message));
493:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
494:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
495:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
496:             g_channel_ids[i]);
497:         }
498: 
499:       active->callback = channel->callback;
500:       active->arg = channel->arg;
501:       active->channel_index = i;
502:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
503:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
504:       if (ret < 0)
505:         {
506:           return ret;
507:         }
508: 
509:       active->busy = true;
510:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
511:         {
512:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
513:             {
514:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
515:             }
516: 
517:           g_probe_attempts++;
518:           g_stats.probes++;
519:         }
520: 
521:       return OK;
522:     }
523: 
524:   return OK;
525: }

527: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
528:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
529: {
530:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
531: 
532:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
533:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
534:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
535:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
536:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
537:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
538:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
539: }
540: 
541: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
542: {
543:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
544:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
545:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
546: }
547: 
548: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
549: {
550:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
551:   struct active_transaction *active;
552:   bool replay;
553:   int result;
554: 
555:   active = busy_probe();
556:   if (active == NULL)
557:     {
558:       active = &g_active;
559:     }
560: 
561:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
562:     {
563:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
564:       return;
565:     }
566: 
567:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
568:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
569:     {
570:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
571: 
572:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
573:       return;
574:     }
575: 
576:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
577:     {
578:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
579:       return;
580:     }
581: 
582:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
583:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
584: 
585:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
586:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
587:     {
588:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
589:     }
590: 
591:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
592:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
593:   if (replay)
594:     {
595:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
596:       unsigned int i;
597: 
598:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
599:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
600:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
601:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
602:        */
603: 
604:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
605:       g_active.quarantine = false;
606:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
607:         {
608:           if (i != replay_index)
609:             {
610:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
611:             }
612:         }
613: 
614:       select_recovery_epoch();
615:       (void)dispatch_locked();
616:       return;
617:     }
618: 
619:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
620: 
621:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
622:     {
623:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
624:         {
625:           release_recovery_slots();
626:           g_recovery_index = 0;
627:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
628:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
629:         }
630:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
631:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
632:         {
633:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
634:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
635:            */
636:         }
637:       else
638:         {
639:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
640:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
641:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
642:         }
643:     }
644: 
645:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
646:            result < 0)
647:     {
648:       begin_abort(result);
649:     }
650: 
651:   (void)dispatch_locked();
652: }
653: 
654: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
655: {
656:   struct ack_slot *slot;
657:   unsigned int rx_index;
658:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
659:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
660:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
661:   uint8_t state = 0;
662:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
663: 
664:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
665:     {
666:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
667:       if (slot == NULL)
668:         {
669:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
670:           return -EAGAIN;
671:         }
672:     }
673:   else
674:     {
675:       slot = NULL;
676:     }
677: 
678:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
679:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
680:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
681:     {
682:       g_stats.bad_header++;
683:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
684:     }
685:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
686:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
687:     {
688:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
689:                                      g_rx_args[rx_index]);
690:       if (ret < 0)
691:         {
692:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
693:         }
694:     }
695:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
696:     {
697:       g_pwc_rx(message);
698:       ret = OK;
699:     }
700:   else
701:     {
702:       g_stats.unsupported++;
703:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
704:     }
705: 
706:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
707:     {
708:       return OK;
709:     }
710: 
711:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
712:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
713:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
714:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
715:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
716: 
717:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
718:     {
719:       g_probe_requested = true;
720:     }
721: 
722:   (void)dispatch_locked();
723:   return OK;
724: }
725: 
726: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
727: {
728:   irqstate_t flags;
729:   uint8_t control;
730: 
731:   flags = up_irq_save();
732:   g_stats.rx++;
733:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
734: 
735:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
736:     {
737:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
738:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
739:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
740:         {
741:           g_stats.bad_header++;
742:         }
743:       else
744:         {
745:           g_stats.resets++;
746:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
747:         }
748:     }
749:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
750:     {
751:       handle_ack(message);
752:     }
753:   else
754:     {
755:       int ret = handle_command(message);
756: 
757:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
758:         {
759:           up_irq_restore(flags);
760:           return ret;
761:         }
762:     }
763: 
764:   up_irq_restore(flags);
765:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
766:   return OK;
767: }

769: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
770: {
771:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
772: 
773:   (void)argc;
774:   (void)argv;
775:   for (;;)
776:     {
777:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
778:       irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
779:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
780:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
781:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
782:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
783:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
784:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
785: 
786:       up_irq_restore(flags);
787:       if (reported == state)
788:         {
789:           continue;
790:         }
791: 
792:       reported = state;
793:       if (reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
794:           reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
795:         {
796:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
797:                  "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
798:                  reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
799:                  (unsigned long)bad_ack);
800:         }
801: 
802:       if (callback != NULL)
803:         {
804:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
805:         }
806:     }
807: 
808:   return OK;
809: }

811: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
812: {
813:   (void)argc;
814:   (void)argv;
815: 
816:   for (;;)
817:     {
818:       struct active_transaction *probe;
819:       irqstate_t flags;
820:       bool request_probe;
821: 
822:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
823:       flags = up_irq_save();
824: 
825:       probe = busy_probe();
826:       if ((g_active.busy &&
827:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
828:           (probe != NULL &&
829:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
830:         {
831:           g_stats.timeout++;
832:           if (probe != NULL)
833:             {
834:               probe->quarantine = true;
835:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
836:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
837:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
838:             }
839:           else
840:             {
841:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
842:             }
843:         }
844: 
845:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
846:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
847:         {
848:           select_recovery_epoch();
849:         }
850: 
851:       (void)dispatch_locked();
852:       if (g_probe_requested && ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
853:         {
854:           g_probe_requested = false;
855:         }
856: 
857:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
858:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
859:                       !g_channels[4].queued && !g_active.busy;
860:       if (request_probe)
861:         {
862:           g_probe_requested = false;
863:         }
864: 
865:       up_irq_restore(flags);
866: 
867:       if (request_probe)
868:         {
869:           bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
870:         }
871:     }
872: 
873:   return OK;
874: }

937: int bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(uint8_t logical_channel,
938:                              const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
939:                              bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback, void *arg)
940: {
941:   struct logical_channel *channel;
942:   unsigned int index;
943:   irqstate_t flags;
944:   int ret;
945: 
946:   if (!g_initialized || !g_physical_started || message == NULL)
947:     {
948:       return -EAGAIN;
949:     }
950: 
951:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
952:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
953:     {
954:       return -EINVAL;
955:     }
956: 
957:   flags = up_irq_save();
958:   channel = &g_channels[index];
959:   if (channel->queued)
960:     {
961:       up_irq_restore(flags);
962:       return -EBUSY;
963:     }
964: 
965:   if (g_link_state != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
966:       !(g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
967:         logical_channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
968:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE))
969:     {
970:       up_irq_restore(flags);
971:       return -ENOLINK;
972:     }
973: 
974:   if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY && g_active.quarantine)
975:     {
976:       up_irq_restore(flags);
977:       return -ENOLINK;
978:     }
979: 
980:   memset(&channel->pending, 0, sizeof(channel->pending));
981:   memcpy(&channel->pending, message, sizeof(channel->pending));
982:   channel->callback = callback;
983:   channel->arg = arg;
984:   channel->result = -EINPROGRESS;
985:   channel->queued = true;
986:   ret = dispatch_locked();
987:   if (ret < 0 && ret != -EAGAIN)
988:     {
989:       channel->queued = false;
990:       channel->result = ret;
991:     }
992: 
993:   up_irq_restore(flags);
994:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
995:   return ret == -EAGAIN ? OK : ret;
996: }

998: int bk7258_mailbox_register_rx(uint8_t logical_channel,
999:                                bk7258_mb_channel_rx_t callback, void *arg)
1000: {
1001:   unsigned int index = rx_channel_index(logical_channel);
1002: 
1003:   if (index >= MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT)
1004:     {
1005:       return -EINVAL;
1006:     }
1007:

210: {
211: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
212: 
213: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
214: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(data, src, dst, arg);

220: static bool mb_chnl_rx_ready(void)
221: {
222: 	return ack_count < MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;

225: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
226: {
227: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
228: 
229: 	while (1)
230: 	{
231: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
232: 		bk_err_t ret;
233: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
234: 
235: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
236: 		{
237: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
238: 			return;
239: 		}
240: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
241: 		ack_sending = 1;
242: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
243: 
244: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
245: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
246: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
247: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
248: 		{
249: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
250: 			ack_sending = 0;
251: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
252: 			return;
253: 		}
254: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
255: 		ack_count--;
256: 		ack_sending = 0;
257: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
258: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
259: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
260: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
261: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
262: 	}
263: }

265: static bool mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(u8 destination, const mailbox_data_t *data)
266: {
267: 	u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
268: 	mb_ack_entry_t *entry;
269: 
270: 	if (ack_count >= MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN)
271: 	{
272: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[destination].ack_queue_full_cnt++;
273: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
274: 		return false;
275: 	}
276: 	entry = &ack_queue[ack_write];
277: 	entry->data = *data;
278: 	entry->destination = destination;
279: 	ack_write = (ack_write + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
280: 	ack_count++;
281: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
282: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
283: 	return true;
284: }

286: static void mb_chnl_notify(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *log_chnl_cb_x, u8 count,

290: 
291: 	for (i = 0; i < count; i++)

329: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
330: {
331: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
332: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
333: 	u16 			chnl_type;
334: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
335: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
336: 
337: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
338: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
339: 
340: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
341: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
342: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
343: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
344: #endif
345: 
346: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
347: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
348: 
349: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
350: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
351: 
352: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
353: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
354: 
355: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
356: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
357: 
358: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
359: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
360: 
361: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
362: 
363: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
364: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
365: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
366: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
367: 
368: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
369: 
370: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
371: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
372: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
373: 
374: 	__DMB();
375: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
376: 
377: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
378: 
379: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
380: 
381: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
382: 	{
383: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
384: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
385: 
386: 		return ret_code;
387: 	}
388: 
389: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
390: 
391: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
392: 
393: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
394: 	{
395: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
396: 	}
397: 
398: 	return BK_OK;
399: }

401: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
402: {
403: 	u8		log_chnl;
404: 	u8		ret_code;
405: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
406: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
407: 
408: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
409: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
410: 
411: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
412: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
413: 	{
414: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
415: 
416: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
417: 		if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != (CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX | CHNL_CTRL_RESET) ||
418: 			ack_ptr->hdr.state != 0 || ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != 0 ||
419: 			ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != 0 || ack_ptr->data1 != 0 ||
420: 			ack_ptr->data2 != 0 || ack_ptr->data3 != 0 ||
421: 			GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
422: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
423: 		{
424: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
425: 			if (phy_chnl_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM)
426: 				phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx].reset_bad_cnt++;
427: 			return;
428: 		}
429: 
430: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
431: 		phy_chnl_ptr->recovering = 1;
432: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
433: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
434: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
435: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
436: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
437: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
438: 		{
439: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
440: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
441: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
442: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
443: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
444: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
445: 			{
446: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
447: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
448: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
449: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
450: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
451: 			}
452: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
453: 		}
454: 		else
455: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
456: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
457: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
458: 		return;
459: 	}
460: 
461: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
462: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
463: 
464: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
465: 
466: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
467: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
468: 		return;
469: 	}
470: 
471: 
472: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
473: 	{
474: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
475: 		return;
476: 	}
477: 
478: 
479: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
480: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
481: 		return;
482: 	}
483: 
484: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
485: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
486: 
487: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
488: 	{
489: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
490: 		return;
491: 	}
492: 
493: 	u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
494: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY ||
495: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
496: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
497: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
498: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
499: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
500: 	{
501: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
502: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
503: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
504: 		return;
505: 	}
506: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
507: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
508: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
509: 
510: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
511: 
512: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
513: 	{
514: 		/* clear following header members. */
515: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
516: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
517: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
518: 
519: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
520: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
521: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
522: 	} else {
523: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
524: 	}
525: 
526: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
527: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
528: 	{
529: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
530: 		return;
531: 	}
532: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
533: 	{
534: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
535: 			break;
536: 	}
537: 
538: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
539: 	{
540: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
541: 		return;
542: 	}
543: 
544: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
545: 
546: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
547: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
548: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
549: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
550: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
551: 
552: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
553: 
554: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
555: 	{
556: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
557: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
558: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
559: 	}
560: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
561: 
562: 	return;
563: 
564: }

566: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
567: {
568: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
569: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
570: 
571: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
572: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
573: 
574: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
575: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
576: 
577: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
578: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
579: 
580: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
581: 
582: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
583: 		return;
584: 
585: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
586: 		return;
587: 
588: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
589: 		return;
590: 
591: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
592: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
593: 
594: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
595: 
596: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
597: 	{
598: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
599: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
600: 
601: 		return;
602: 	}
603: 
604: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
605: 	{
606: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
607: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
608: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
609: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
610: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
611: 
612: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
613: 
614: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
615: 	}
616: 	else
617: 	{
618: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
619: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
620: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
621: 	}
622: 
623: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
624: 	{
625: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
626: 		return;
627: 	}
628: 
629: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
630: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
631: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
632: 
633: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
634: 	{
635: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
636: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
637: 		return;
638: 	}
639: 	return;
640: }
641: 
642: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
643: {
644: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
645: 
646: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
647: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
648: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
649: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
650: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
651: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
652: 
653: 	/*
654: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
655: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
656: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
657: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
658: 	 */
659: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
660: 	{
661: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
662: 	}
663: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
664: 	{
665: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
666: 	}
667: }

669: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
670: {
671: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
672: 
673: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
674: 
675: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
676: 
677: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
678: 
679: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
680: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
681: 
682: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
683: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
684: 
685: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
686: 
687: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
688: 	{
689: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
690: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
691: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
692: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
693: 
694: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
695: 
696: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
697: 		{
698: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
699: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
700: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
701: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
702: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
703: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
704: 
705: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
706: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
707: 			}
708: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
709: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
710: 			return ret_code;
711: 		}
712: 	}
713: 
714: 	return BK_OK;
715: }

717: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
718: 
719: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
720: {
721: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
722: 	u16 			chnl_type;
723: 
724: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
725: 
726: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
727: 
728: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
729: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
730: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
731: #endif
732: 
733: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
734: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
735: 
736: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
737: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
738: 
739: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
740: 
741: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
742: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
743: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
744: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
745: 
746: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
747: 
748: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
749: 
750: 	/*
751: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
752: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
753: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
754: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
755: 	 */
756: 	while(1)
757: 	{
758: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
759: 
760: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
761: 		{
762: 			break;
763: 		}
764: 	}
765: 
766: 	return ret_code;
767: }

770: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
771: /*
772:   * init logical chnanel module.
773:   * return:
774:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
775:   *     failed  : fail code.
776:   *
777:   */
778: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
779: {
780: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
781: 	int				i, j;
782: 
783: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
784: 
785: 	/*
786: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
787: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
788: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
789: 	 * can race here:
790: 	 *
791: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
792: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
793: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
794: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
795: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
796: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
797: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
798: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
799: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
800: 	 *
801: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
802: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
803: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
804: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
805: 	 */
806: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
807: 	{
808: 		return BK_OK;
809: 	}
810: 
811: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
812: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
813: 	{
814: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
815: 		return BK_OK;
816: 	}
817: 
818: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
819: 	memset(ack_queue, 0, sizeof(ack_queue));
820: 	ack_read = 0;
821: 	ack_write = 0;
822: 	ack_count = 0;
823: 	ack_sending = 0;
824: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
825: 	{
826: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
827: 
828: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
829: 
830: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
831: 
832: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
833: 		{
834: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
835: 		}
836: 	}
837: 
838: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
839: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
840: 	{
841: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
842: 		return ret_code;
843: 	}
844: 
845: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
846: 
847: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
848: 	{
849: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
850: 
851: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
852: 	}
853: 
854: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
855: 	bk_mailbox_rx_ready_callback_register(mb_chnl_rx_ready);
856: 
857: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
858: 
859: 	return BK_OK;
860: }

862: /*
863:   * open logical chnanel.
864:   * input:
865:   *     log_chnl  : logical channel id to open.
866:   *     callback_param : param passsed to all callbacks.
867:   * return:
868:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
869:   *     failed  : fail code.

871:   */
872: bk_err_t mb_chnl_open(u8 log_chnl, void * callback_param)
873: {
874: 	if(!mb_chnnl_init_ok)	/* if driver is not initialized. */
875: 	{
876: 		bk_err_t		ret_code;
877: 
878: 		ret_code = mb_chnl_init();
879: 
880: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
881: 		{
882: 			return ret_code;
883: 		}
884: 	}
885: 
886: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
887: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
888: 
889: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
890: 
891: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
892: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
893: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
894: #endif
895: 
896: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
897: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
898: 
899: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
900: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
901: 
902: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
903: 
904: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
905: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
906: 
907: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used)
908: 		return BK_ERR_OPEN;

910: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used = 1;		/* chnl in used. */

913: 	return BK_OK;

916: /*
917:   * close logical chnanel.
918:   * input:
919:   *     log_chnl  : logical channel id to close.
920:   * return:
921:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
922:   *     failed  : fail code.
923:   *
924:   */
925: bk_err_t mb_chnl_close(u8 log_chnl)
926: {
927: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
928: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
929: 
930: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
931: 
932: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
933: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
934: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
935: #endif
936: 
937: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
938: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
939: 
940: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
941: 
942: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
943: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
944: 
945: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
946: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
947:

969: {

974:   * write to logical chnanel.
975:   * input:
976:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
977:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
978:   * return:
979:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
980:   *     failed  : fail code.
981:   *
982:   */
983: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
984: {
985: 	u16		write_len;
986: 
987: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
988: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
989: 
990: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
991: 
992: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
993: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
994: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
995: #endif
996: 
997: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
998: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
999: 
1000: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
1001: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1002: 
1003: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
1004: 
1005: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
1006: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1007: 
1008: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
1009: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
1010: 
1011: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1012: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
1013: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t *logical_cmd = cmd_buf;
1014: 
1015: 	if (phy->recovering &&
1016: 		!(log_chnl == MB_CHNL_UART0 &&
1017: 		  logical_cmd->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_STATE_COMMAND))
1018: 	{
1019: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1020: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1021: 	}
1022: 
1023: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
1024: 	{
1025: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1026: 
1027: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1028: 	}
1029: 
1030: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
1031: 
1032: 	memset(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, 0,
1033: 	       sizeof(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff));
1034: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
1035: 
1036: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
1037: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
1038: 	__DMB();
1039: 
1040: 	bk_err_t start_ret = mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
1041: 
1042: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1043: 
1044: 	return start_ret;
1045: }

1047: /*
1048:   * logical chnanel misc io (set/get param).
1049:   * input:
1050:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to set/get param.
1051:   *     cmd          : control command for logical channel.
1052:   *     param      :  parameter of the command.
1053:   * return:
1054:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
1055:   *     failed  : fail code.
1056:   *
1057:   */
1058: bk_err_t mb_chnl_ctrl(u8 log_chnl, u8 cmd, void * param)
1059: {
1060: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
1061: 
1062: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
1063: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
1064: 
1065: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
1066: 
1067: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
1068: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
1069: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1070: #endif
1071: 
1072: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
1073: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1074: 
1075: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
1076: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1077: 
1078: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
1079: 
1080: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
1081: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1082: 
1083: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
1084: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
1085: 
1086: 	switch(cmd)
1087: 	{
1088: 		case MB_CHNL_GET_STATUS:
1089: 
1090: 			if(param == NULL)
1091: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
1092: 
1093: 			*((u8 *)param) = log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state;
1094: 
1095: 			break;
1096: 
1097: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR:
1098: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr = (chnl_rx_isr_t)param;
1099: 			break;
1100: 
1101: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR:
1102: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr = (chnl_tx_isr_t)param;
1103: 			break;
1104: 
1105: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR:
1106: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr = (chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t)param;
1107: 			break;
1108: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR:
1109: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].event_isr = (chnl_event_isr_t)param;
1110: 			break;
1111: 
1112: 		case MB_CHNL_WRITE_SYNC:
1113: 			if(param == NULL)
1114: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
1115: 
1116: 			ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(log_chnl, (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)param);
1117: 			return ret_code;
1118: 			break;
1119: 
1120: 		default:
1121: 			return BK_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
1122: 			break;
1123: 	}
1124: 
1125: 	return BK_OK;
1126: }

1128: void mb_chnl_poll(void)
1129: {
1130: 	u8 phy_idx;
1131: 
1132: 	bk_mailbox_poll();
1133: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
1134: 
1135: 	for (phy_idx = 0; phy_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM; phy_idx++)
1136: 	{
1137: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_idx];
1138: 		mb_log_chnl_cb_t *logs;
1139: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
1140: 		u8 log_idx;
1141: 
1142: 		u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1143: 		if ((phy->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY) || !phy->busy_since_ms ||
1144: 			((u32)(rtos_get_time() - phy->busy_since_ms) < MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS))
1145: 		{
1146: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1147: 			continue;
1148: 		}
1149: 		phy->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
1150: 		phy->busy_since_ms = 0;
1151: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1152: 
1153: 		logs = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_idx];
1154: 		log_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy->tx_log_chnl);
1155: 		if (log_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx])
1156: 			continue;
1157: 
1158: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt++;
1159: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;
1160: 		bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_idx);
1161: 		phy->recovering = 1;
1162: 		memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
1163: 		failure.hdr.cmd = phy->tx_hdr_cmd;
1164: 		failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
1165: 		if (logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
1166: 			logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(logs[log_idx].isr_param, &failure);
1167: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx]);
1168: 		mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1169: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT);
1170: 		if (mb_phy_chnl_send_reset(phy_idx, phy->tx_log_chnl) == BK_OK)
1171: 			mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1172: 					   MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT);
1173: 		else
1174: 			mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1175: 					   MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED);
1176: 	}
1177: }

1179: bk_err_t mb_chnl_get_diag(u8 peer_cpu, mb_chnl_diag_t *diag)
1180: {
1181: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy;
1182: 
1183: 	if (!diag)
1184: 		return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
1185: 	if (peer_cpu >= PHY_CHNL_NUM || peer_cpu == SELF_CPU)
1186: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1187: 
1188: 	phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[peer_cpu];
1189: 	diag->busy = phy->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
1190: 	diag->logical_chnl = phy->tx_log_chnl;
1191: 	diag->sequence = phy->tx_seq;
1192: 	diag->command = phy->tx_hdr_cmd;
1193: 	diag->stale_ack = phy->rx_fault_cnt;
1194: 	diag->tx_fault = phy->tx_fault_cnt;
1195: 	diag->ack_retry = phy->ack_retry_cnt;
1196: 	diag->ack_queue_full = phy->ack_queue_full_cnt;
1197: 	diag->reset_bad = phy->reset_bad_cnt;
1198: 	return BK_OK;
1199: }

46: /*
47:  * Coexistence netif wire id (2-bit co_hdr.vif_idx). Roles are NOT pinned to a
48:  * fixed LMAC VIF index any more (P2P GO/GC float on vif0/vif1 so the MCC
49:  * channel scheduler can handle them). We therefore key the wire id off the
50:  * (netif type, p2p) role instead of the LMAC index:
51:  *
52:  *   wire 0 = infra STA   (STA-type, !p2p) -> host g_mlan
53:  *   wire 1 = SoftAP      (AP-type,  !p2p) -> host g_uap
54:  *   wire 2 = P2P GO      (AP-type,   p2p) -> host g_p2p_go
55:  *   wire 3 = P2P GC      (STA-type,  p2p) -> host g_p2p_gc
56:  *
57:  * The TX path is symmetric: host tags the wire id, CP maps it back to the
58:  * current LMAC VIF index via cif_wire_to_lmac_vif() (no longer identity).
59:  */
60: static uint8_t cif_vif_to_netif_wire(void *vif)
61: {
62:     netif_if_t t = wifi_netif_vif_to_netif_type(vif);
63:     bool p2p = cif_vif_is_p2p(vif);
64: 
65:     if ((t == NETIF_IF_AP) && p2p)
66:         return 2;
67:     if ((t == NETIF_IF_STA) && p2p)
68:         return 3;
69: 
70:     return (uint8_t)t;
71: }
72: 
73: /*
74:  * Reverse of cif_vif_to_netif_wire(): map a host wire id back to the LMAC VIF
75:  * index currently held by that role. Since GO/GC float on vif0/vif1, the old
76:  * identity mapping (wire==index) no longer holds, so look the role up in the
77:  * active VIF table. Falls back to the wire id if no active match is found.
78:  */
79: static uint8_t cif_wire_to_lmac_vif(uint8_t wire)
80: {
81:     netif_if_t want_type;
82:     bool want_p2p;
83: 
84:     switch (wire)
85:     {
86:         case 0: want_type = NETIF_IF_STA; want_p2p = false; break;
87:         case 1: want_type = NETIF_IF_AP;  want_p2p = false; break;
88:         case 2: want_type = NETIF_IF_AP;  want_p2p = true;  break;
89:         case 3: want_type = NETIF_IF_STA; want_p2p = true;  break;
90:         default: return wire;
91:     }
92: 
93:     for (void *vif = mac_vif_mgmt_first_vif(); vif != NULL;
94:          vif = mac_vif_mgmt_next_vif(vif))
95:     {
96:         if ((wifi_netif_vif_to_netif_type(vif) == want_type) &&
97:             (cif_vif_is_p2p(vif) == want_p2p))
98:             return wifi_netif_vif_to_vifid(vif);
99:     }
100: 
101:     return wire;
102: }

354:  * Name: mpu_log2regionceil
355:  *
356:  * Description:
357:  *   Determine the smallest value of l2size (log base 2 size) such that the
358:  *   following is true:
359:  *
360:  *   size <= (1 << l2size)
361:  *
362:  * Input Parameters:
363:  *   size - The size of the region.
364:  *
365:  * Returned Value:
366:  *   The logarithm base 2 of the ceiling value for the MPU region size.

370: uint8_t mpu_log2regionceil(size_t size)
371: {
372:   uint8_t l2size;
373: 
374:   /* The minimum permitted region size is 32 bytes (log2(32) = 5. */
375: 
376:   for (l2size = 5; l2size < 32 && size > (1 << l2size); l2size++);

693: /****************************************************************************
694:  * Function: netdev_upper_rxpoll_work
695:  *
696:  * Description:

698:  *   stack and send packets which is from IP stack if necessary.
699:  *
700:  * Input Parameters:

702:  *

708: static void netdev_upper_rxpoll_work(FAR struct netdev_upperhalf_s *upper)
709: {

712:   FAR netpkt_t                  *pkt;
713: 
714:   /* Loop while receive() successfully retrieves valid Ethernet frames. */
715: 
716:   netdev_lock(dev);
717:   while ((pkt = lower->ops->receive(lower)) != NULL)
718:     {
719:       if (!IFF_IS_UP(dev->d_flags))
720:         {
721:           /* Interface down, drop frame */
722: 
723:           NETDEV_RXDROPPED(dev);

742: #endif

118: 		ctrl = (rx_desc[i].data.param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
119: 		if (((ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0) != priority)
120: 			continue;
121: 		if (!oldest || (int32_t)(rx_desc[i].order - oldest->order) < 0)
122: 			oldest = &rx_desc[i];

127: static mbox0_stable_slot_t *mbox0_alloc_slot(u8 dst, u8 ctrl,
128: 					     u8 *kind, u8 *index)
129: {
130: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
131: 	u8 i;
132: 
133: 	if (ctrl == (MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX | MBOX0_CTRL_RESET))
134: 	{
135: 		if (slots->reset_used)
136: 			return NULL;
137: 		slots->reset_used = 1;
138: 		slots->reset_order = ++slots->publish_order;
139: 		*kind = 2;
140: 		return &slots->reset;
141: 	}
142: 
143: 	if (ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
144: 	{
145: 		for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
146: 		{
147: 			if (!slots->ack_used[i])
148: 			{
149: 				slots->ack_used[i] = 1;
150: 				slots->ack_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
151: 				*kind = 1;
152: 				*index = i;
153: 				return &slots->ack[i];
154: 			}
155: 		}
156: 		return NULL;
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	if (ctrl == MBOX0_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
160: 	{
161: 		if (slots->sync_used)
162: 			return NULL;
163: 		slots->sync_used = 1;
164: 		slots->sync_order = ++slots->publish_order;
165: 		*kind = 3;
166: 		return &slots->sync;
167: 	}
168: 
169: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
170: 	{
171: 		if (!slots->cmd_used[i])
172: 		{
173: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 1;
174: 			slots->cmd_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
175: 			slots->cmd_active = i + 1;
176: 			*kind = 0;
177: 			*index = i;
178: 			return &slots->cmd[i];
179: 		}
180: 	}
181: 
182: 	return NULL;
183: }

196: 		slots->ack_used[index] = 0;

203: void bk_mailbox_poll(void)
204: {
205: 	u8 dst;
206: 
207: 	u32 flags = rtos_disable_int();
208: 	for (dst = 0; dst < MBOX_CHNL_NUM; dst++)
209: 	{
210: 		if (dst != MAILBOX_CPU0)
211: 			mbox0_reap_slots(dst);
212: 	}
213: 	mbox0_drv_poll();
214: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
215: 
216: 	while (1)
217: 	{
218: 		mbox0_rx_desc_t desc;
219: 		mbox0_rx_desc_t *selected;
220: 
221: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
222: 		if (!rx_count)
223: 		{
224: 			rtos_enable_int(flags);
225: 			break;
226: 		}
227: 		selected = mbox0_oldest_desc(true);
228: 		if (!selected)
229: 			selected = mbox0_oldest_desc(false);
230: 		if (!selected ||
231: 			(((selected->data.param0 >> 12) & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 &&
232: 			 upper_rx_ready && !upper_rx_ready()))
233: 		{
234: 			rtos_enable_int(flags);
235: 			break;
236: 		}
237: 		desc = *selected;
238: 		selected->used = 0;
239: 		rx_count--;
240: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
241: 		if (mailbox_callback[desc.source])
242: 			mailbox_callback[desc.source](&desc.data);
243: 
244: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
245: 		mbox0_drv_poll();
246: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
247: 	}
248: }

250: static void mbox0_rx_isr(mbox0_message_t *msg)
251: {
252: 	u32 address;
253: 	u32 source;
254: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *desc;
255: 	u8 i;
256: 
257: 	if (!msg)
258: 		return;
259: 
260: 	source = msg->src_cpu;
261: 	if (source != MAILBOX_CPU1)
262: 	{
263: 		adapter_diag.bad_sid++;
264: 		return;
265: 	}
266: 	if (msg->data[1] != sizeof(mailbox_data_t))
267: 	{
268: 		adapter_diag.bad_length++;
269: 		return;
270: 	}
271: 
272: 	address = msg->data[0];
273: 	if (address & 0x3u)
274: 	{
275: 		adapter_diag.bad_alignment++;
276: 		return;
277: 	}
278: 	if (address > UINT32_MAX - sizeof(mailbox_data_t) ||
279: 		address < MBOX0_AP_RAM_START ||
280: 		address + sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > MBOX0_AP_RAM_END)
281: 	{
282: 		adapter_diag.bad_address++;
283: 		return;
284: 	}
285: 	if (rx_count >= MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM)
286: 	{
287: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
288: 		return;
289: 	}
290: 
291: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
292: 	SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((void *)address, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
293: #endif
294: 	__DMB();
295: 	desc = NULL;
296: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM; i++)
297: 	{
298: 		if (!rx_desc[i].used)
299: 		{
300: 			desc = &rx_desc[i];
301: 			break;
302: 		}
303: 	}
304: 	if (!desc)
305: 	{
306: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
307: 		return;
308: 	}
309: 	memcpy(&desc->data, (void *)address, sizeof(desc->data));
310: 	desc->source = source;
311: 	desc->order = ++rx_order;
312: 	desc->used = 1;
313: 	rx_count++;
314: 
315: }

347: bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src,
348: 			 mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
349: {
350: 	mbox0_message_t message;
351: 	mbox0_stable_slot_t *slot;
352: 	uint32_t fifo_status;
353: 	u8 ctrl;
354: 	u8 kind = 0;
355: 	u8 index = 0;
356: 	int ret_code;
357: 
358: 	(void)arg;
359: 	if (src != MAILBOX_CPU0 || dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
360: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
361: 	if (!data)
362: 		return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
363: 
364: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_get_send_stat(dst, &fifo_status);
365: 	if (ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
366: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
367: 	if (fifo_status & RX_FIFO_STAT_FULL)
368: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT;
369: 
370: 	ctrl = (data->param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
371: 	mbox0_reap_slots(dst);
372: 	slot = mbox0_alloc_slot(dst, ctrl, &kind, &index);
373: 	if (!slot)
374: 	{
375: 		adapter_diag.tx_slot_busy++;
376: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
377: 	}
378: 
379: 	memset(slot, 0, sizeof(*slot));
380: 	memcpy(&slot->data, data, sizeof(slot->data));
381: 	mailbox_slots[dst].fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
382: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
383: 	SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((u32 *)slot, sizeof(*slot));
384: #endif
385: 	__DMB();
386: 	message.data[0] = (u32)&slot->data;
387: 	message.data[1] = sizeof(slot->data);
388: 	message.dest_cpu = dst;
389: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_send_message(&message);
390: 	if (ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
391: 	{
392: 		mbox0_release_slot(dst, kind, index);
393: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_NOT_INIT;
394: 	}
395: 	return BK_OK;
396: }

398: void bk_mailbox_tx_complete(mailbox_endpoint_t dst)
399: {
400: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
401: 	u32 completed_order;
402: 	u8 i;
403: 
404: 	if (dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
405: 		return;
406: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
407: 	if (!slots->cmd_active)
408: 		return;
409: 	completed_order = slots->cmd_order[slots->cmd_active - 1];
410: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
411: 	{
412: 		if (slots->ack_used[i] && slots->ack_order[i] < completed_order)
413: 			slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
414: 	}
415: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
416: 	{
417: 		if (slots->cmd_used[i] && slots->cmd_order[i] <= completed_order)
418: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
419: 	}
420: 	if (slots->reset_used && slots->reset_order < completed_order)
421: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
422: 	if (slots->sync_used && slots->sync_order < completed_order)
423: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
424: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
425: }

**Findings**
1. **Critical: mailbox probing/recovery frees AP TX buffers while CP can still be using them.**  
[bk7258_wifi.c:692](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:692) treats every state except `READY`, including routine `PROBING`, as a link loss.
